title: Detection of atmospheric radon concentration anomalies and their potential for earthquake prediction using Random Forest analysis
summary: Random Forest residuals identified historical radon anomalies before the Kobe and Tohoku-oki earthquakes at two observation sites. This supports a retrospective geophysical association only; it does not validate prospective earthquake prediction.
